text: This is the agent you've built.
Every time it runs, it leaves a trace.
When your agent fails,
the trace can tell you why.
The insights you need to make your agents efficient, fast, and reliable are hidden across thousands of traces.
If only someone could read them all.
Cheap LLMs fail to find crucial issues.
Powerful LLMs find deep issues,
but the costs are unsustainable.
Until now.
Introducing Flow-1, our model specialized for trace analysis,
Matching GPT-6 Sol in trace analysis intelligence,
while analyzing 20 times more traces per dollar.
Flow-1 powers Signals,
our agent built to analyze traces at scale.
It finds deep issues and reports them.
Not just with labels,
but with any structure you define
across every trace.
It clusters issues into high-level patterns
ready for you or your coding agent.
Unlock the insights hiding in millions of agent traces
with Laminar.
